en: Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone market square bordered by 3–4‑story townhouses and a prominent historic building with a steep tiled roof and tall spire on the right, resembling a town hall. On the left are arcaded shopfronts with display windows and people walking along the street. In the far background stand additional gabled houses and church spires. The scene is calm with only a few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing.
